title: Can not install milvus SDK
body:
### Checklist

- [X] I have searched the [existing issues](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues) for similar issues.
- [X] I added a very descriptive title to this issue.
- [X] I have provided sufficient information below to help reproduce this issue.

### Summary

I am trying to use milvus SDK in streamlit and deloy it but the building app got stuck in 
Building wheel for grpcio-tools (setup.py): still running...
![image](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/assets/107928828/b0ba3b64-e9e4-4eeb-9df7-dae6e8c1f1fd)


### Reproducible Code Example

```Python
streamlit==1.32.2
pymilvus==2.4.1
google-generativeai==0.5.0

this is my requirement.txt file

https://stackoverflow.com/questions/56357794/unable-to-install-grpcio-using-pip-install-grpcio i also found this fix on stackoverflow
```


### Steps To Reproduce

1. create a streamlit app which use milvus sdk: pip install milvus
2. deploy it 

### Expected Behavior

It should be able to download milvus and run

### Current Behavior

_No response_

### Is this a regression?

- [ ] Yes, this used to work in a previous version.

### Debug info

- Streamlit version:  1.32.2
- Python version: 3.12
- Operating System: Windows 100
- Browser: Google

### Additional Information

_No response_
